title: Space
description: PROVISIONAL (pending founder WhatsApp handoff, 2026-08-12). A real place or grouping inside an institution where everyday life happens and moments flow: a class, a section, a hostel, a hostel floor, a room, a club. Spaces nest via parentSpaceId (hostel > floor > room).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

institutionId.description: Id of the Institution this space belongs to.

kind.description: What sort of space this is. Minimal set from the founder's stated examples (class, dorm, club) plus the obvious Indian-college companions; expected to grow via minor bumps once the handoff lands.

name.description: How people name this space (e.g. 'Hostel 7', 'Second floor', 'Room 214', 'CSE-A', 'Dramatics Club').

parentSpaceId.description: Id of the enclosing Space, if this space nests inside another (a floor inside a hostel, a room inside a floor).

cohortId.description: Id of the Cohort this space serves, if it is cohort-bound (a section or class usually is; a hostel usually is not).

capacity.description: How many people this space holds, where that is a real constraint (rooms, hostels).
